fields.Name: T155 - Pipeline Validate Feedback
fields.Description: Exercises the pipeline validate() client-side spec sanity check + notification path — a distinct branch from render, save, or train.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Predictive Studio app, open the 'Studio' door and the 'Training Pipelines' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. If at least one pipeline pill exists, select it and click the 'Validate' button in the pipeline toolbar. Success is a notification/toast appearing that reports the client-side spec check result — either 'Pipeline looks valid — ready to train.' or a message naming what the pipeline still needs (e.g. a target variable / an algorithm). If there are no pipelines to validate (empty state), confirming the empty state renders is also a pass.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking Validate on a selected pipeline surfaces a validation-result notification (valid, or a list of what's missing), OR the no-pipelines empty state is shown
The Validate action does not require training or saving to produce feedback
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
